t: England captain Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) won the men's Ballon d'Or 2026 at the London Palladium, the first English winner since Michael Owen in 2001; Alexia Putellas won the women's award.

The Keralam Legislative Assembly unanimously passed the Senior Citizens' (Care and Protection of Rights) Bill, 2026, described as the first comprehensive state law on elderly rights in India; cruelty towards senior citizens is punishable with up to three years in jail.
Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva won Brazil's presidential runoff on 25 October 2026 with about 51.8% of the vote against Flavio Bolsonaro, securing a fourth, non-consecutive term.
String theorist Ashoke Sen (ICTS Bengaluru) became the first Indian physicist to receive the Oskar Klein Medal, awarded by Stockholm University and the Nobel Committee for Physics.
Sukhna Wetland (Chandigarh's first Ramsar site) and Sauj Jheel (Mainpuri, Uttar Pradesh) were designated Ramsar sites, taking India's total to 103.
England's Bodhana Sivanandan, 11, became the youngest female International Master, breaking Judit Polgar's record, after earning her final norm at the European Women's Club Cup 2026.
